triggers.detailsText: Revenue up 129%, EBITDA up 172%, profit up 191% because the pattern within these is the real message. The quarter you have just heard, INR690 crores of revenue, profit up by 191%, delivered before a single rupee of the QIP proceed was put to work. It is important to understand that with the same CCV lines, by adding two more aluminum corrugation lines with a minimal capex of INR17 crores, we have opened up 66 and 132 capacity substantially by compromising one line of 33 kV and added more value-added products, so our return on investment becomes stronger.

The details of the above acquisition (as required to be furnished pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Regulations and SEBI Circular No SEBI/HO/49/14/14(7)2025 - CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January, 2026) were provided vide our earlier intimation dated August 01, 2026.
filingKeyFacts: In this regard, we wish to inform that Prataap Snacks Limited ( “the Company ”) has executed a Share Purchase Agreement with the Target Company and existing shareholder(s) of the Target Company for acquisition of 100% of the issued, subscribed and paid -up share capital of the Target Company on August 19, 2026.

The details of the above acquisition (as required to be furnished pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI Listing Regulations and SEBI Circular No SEBI/HO/49/14/14(7)2025 - CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January, 2026) were provided vide our earlier intimation dated August 01, 2026.
